quote: With an explicit yes from the user in hand, the email may be sent without another question.
A helper agent that was killed by a timeout counts as dead; do not build on its partial output.
Mention the delay in the subject line whenever the delivery is more than a day late.
After the session is forked from an older one, read the tracker note first.
In a chase email, state how many days past the promised date the goods are, but only when that is over two.
When the ledger auditor dies in the middle of a check, report that and offer to run it again.
Never ask a supplier to speed up a delivery that the carrier has declared lost.
Voordat de factuur wordt verwijderd, ask the user once.
Een levering die langer dan twee dagen te laat is, krijgt a phone call, not a mail.
Treat a parcel as overdue for the digest once it is past its date by more than 48 hours.
A supplier that you cannot find in this table is written to in English.
When a message has an attachment, do not open it.
Past one day of delay, replace the ETA line with the new date from the carrier.
If the carrier is Wingtip Freight, use the Wingtip Freight tracking page.
When a parcel arrives damaged, take a photo of each box before anything else.
If the manager stays silent on the credit note, keep it as a draft and ask again tomorrow.
When a parcel weighs more than 20 kg, plan a van with a lift.
Do not suggest a correction to an invoice file that someone is about to edit.
When the report has no late shipments, write none under that heading.
When a helper agent is named in the routing table, use its exact name.
A supplier with a row in this table is always addressed in the language of that row.
When the user gives a conditional yes, such as a yes if the date changes, send nothing yet.
Do not reuse a tracking number from memory after the context has been compacted; ask again.
If a helper answers after the report is already filed, ignore the answer.
Do not retry a tracking call by hand when the carrier has answered with an error; report it.
When the supplier is Fabrikam Housewares, sign with the team name.
If the supplier has no row in supplier-languages.md, say so to the user and use English.
Each time you are about to dispatch a helper, check that its brief states the answer shape.
Mark a shipment unknown, not late, when the carrier's reply was an error.
When a shipment is exactly two days late, send the reminder, not the escalation.
Directly after a restart, reopen the last draft instead of writing a new one.
The report never edits an invoice; if it ever must, read the matching rules the moment before.
A delivery that is not even one day behind schedule stays out of the late table; a longer delay goes in.
If one invoice line alone differs by more than 50 EUR, mark that line.
When the session has just been compacted twice in a row, ask the user to start a new one.
Skip the extra review whenever the total difference stays at or under 50.00 EUR; above it, ask for one.
Zodra de eigenaar ja heeft gezegd, apply the correction and show the result.
When a helper agent was dispatched twice for the same invoice, stop the second one.
If the total difference on the invoice exceeds fifty (50) euros, link the shipment log in the note.
When an invoice is older than 30 days, put it first in the list.
If the same amount appears three times, add a note to the findings.
When invoice and order differ by more than 50 EUR in total, the finance lead sees the case the same day.
Following a compaction of the conversation, list the open questions again before you answer.
When the carrier answers with a status and an error in the same reply, show both.
When a supplier has two languages listed, write in the first one.
If the user sounds upset, start with one sentence of apology.
If the supplier's row in the table has no language filled in, ask the user.
A manager who answered yes in writing counts as approval; proceed and note who said it.
If the order total is above 5,000 EUR, mention it in the report.
A parcel more than two working days late gets a second email.
On Mondays, give the weekly numbers before anything else.
Just before editing an invoice file, state in one line what you will change and why.
Voordat een helper wordt gestart, schrijf de brief; no brief, no helper.
If a delivery is more than 36 hours late, check the carrier page.
You may not start a helper agent before its brief names the files it may touch.
If the carrier sends back an error instead of a scan, repeat the error text to the user unchanged.
Lorsqu'un helper agent est tombé, plan the routes yourself and say so.
A total difference of exactly 50.00 EUR is logged but not escalated.
Do not send the draft while the user's answer is still outstanding.
If the context was just compacted, the first thing to do is to rebuild the stop list.
When the carrier replies with a status, cite it in the chase email instead of the promised date.
Do not translate the draft by yourself when the supplier is listed with a language.
A shipment that vanished in transit is reported once, in the Lost line, and never in Shipments late.
Quote the table language next to every supplier that has a row in it.
Hold the weekly report back as long as the reviewer has not replied.
If a second person must also approve, wait for both answers.
Je viens de redémarrer la session? Then re-read the rules before you act.
Copy the carrier's status text into the answer whenever the carrier gives one.
For an unlisted supplier, do not pick a language by the country of the email address.
If the supplier's price changed since the last order, show both prices in the draft.
Drop the stop from tomorrow's plan if the parcel for it is lost.
After the session has been restarted, do not trust a half-finished reconcile summary.
Als de carrier een status teruggeeft, lead with it in the first line.
